notes: Manual behavioral evals. In a fresh session, compare the same prompt with and without this skill using the same model and tools. Grade the response against assertions only after generation; these cases are not run by a repository test runner.

evals.name: full-household-review
evals.prompt: Run a full household portfolio review from this snapshot as of 2026-10-31. Jurisdiction: U.S.; tax year: 2026. Goal: long-term growth. Approved policy: 70% stocks / 30% bonds, rebalance only outside a 5 percentage point band. Taxable account: VTI lot A, 100 shares, market value $30,000, basis $20,000, acquired 2023-01-10; BND lot B, 100 shares, market value $7,000, basis $8,000, acquired 2025-01-10; cash $10,000. Roth IRA: VTI 40 shares, market value $12,000; BND 60 shares, market value $4,200. The snapshot has no purchase history, planned transactions, withdrawal needs, or cash-flow forecast. The host supports separate agents. Give me a proposed action list, including no action where appropriate.
assertions: Freezes the supplied inputs and records snapshot/as-of details and any missing fields.
Runs policy review before maintenance and research; uses separate roles only within host limits.
Merges proposals, checks conflicts and unique action IDs, then includes tax review before reporting.
Presents proposals only and does not change accounts or place orders.

evals.name: blocked-on-material-data
evals.prompt: Review my portfolio and recommend loss-harvesting trades. I have not supplied tax jurisdiction, tax year, holdings, lots, or recent household purchases.
assertions: Marks the material inputs missing and does not invent eligibility, basis, tax savings, or wash-sale clearance.
Stops dependent conclusions and asks for the inputs needed to continue.
Does not make or stage trades.

evals.name: single-position-question
evals.prompt: I own 20 shares of ACME. Can you explain what a 10% price drop would do to that position?
assertions: Answers the narrow arithmetic question without launching the full household review pipeline.
States any assumption needed for the calculation.
Does not infer or recommend a portfolio trade.
